title: deepsearch_dashboard
description: Placeholder contract of templates/assets/deepsearch-dashboard.html (DeepSearch OSINT dashboard v17.02.11, requirement g). The deepsearch-protocol / ai-deepsearch-osint-gathering-report agents fill these {{PLACEHOLDERS}} and nothing else - never the structure, section ids, palette or script. The filled document is delivered as format 'html', so the delivery Function applies gates.deepsearch_dashboard (nine section ids, chart.umd.min.js, spiderChart, downloadReport, no unfilled {{...}}, file > 20 KB) rather than this schema; the template-manager and the preview path validate the placeholder set here. Every key below must be present - an unfilled placeholder fails the gate.

DORA_CRITICALITY.description: e.g. 'In scope - supports a critical or important function' / 'Out of scope'.

OVERALL_RISK_GLYPH.description: HTML entity only - never a literal Unicode glyph (enx-theme.json risk_glyphs, PHASE 4B rule 3).

PROTOCOL_VERSION.description: Template of record version; bumping it is a template change (templates/README.md).

SPIDER_AXIS_LABELS.description: Exactly six pipe-separated axis labels (enx-theme.json charts.radar_axes = 6).

SPIDER_SCORES.description: Six pipe-separated scores on the 1 (low) - 5 (high) axis scale, in the same order as SPIDER_AXIS_LABELS.

SUPPLIER_SLUG.description: Lower-case slug used in the download file name.
